'''Andrew McKelvey''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Pleasanton tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with That Things Operational, according to Alex Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2662">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-lingwo-dead-lingwo-is-deadd2662/ lingwo-dead-lingwo-is-dead], DeckTech (Alex "Black Void" Stefanko, 18 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-lingwo-dead-lingwo-is-deadd2662/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
